# UiPath RPA (Mock)

This is a test fixture mocking the official uipath-rpa skill from the UiPath/skills submodule.

## When to Use

Use this skill when testing override behavior where user or extension skills
should take precedence over the official UiPath skills.

## Procedure

1. Open UiPath Studio
2. Create workflow
3. Deploy to Orchestrator

## Notes

This fixture is used for testing. Do not modify.
This mocks the official skill to avoid depending on the real submodule in tests.
